# The command lines released zminas wrote into a role's start, as the words after the zmina executable: a Claude
# role's hooks (--settings) and a Codex role's bridge. A role keeps its line for its whole life and runs it with
# every zmina installed after it, so each line here must keep resolving. Append only: never edit or remove a line;
# a release that writes a new line or flag adds it with its version (TestHookCommandsResolve says which).
# Values are placeholders; the first word is the first release that wrote the line.
